title: Yon J NDE 8988
content: My experience happened when I was age 18, during the third surgery for an intestinal obstruction. Suddenly, my body was floating on the ceiling and looking down on my body. I saw two doctors and two nurses operating on me while putting my organs in a large basin. I saw my parents crying outside the operating room, but the situation was not scary at all. Suddenly, I was flying through a very dark tunnel at a very high speed. But at the end of the last tunnel, I could see it was very light outside. I could hear the sound of hammering through the tunnel. I couldn't get out of the tunnel until waking up in the hospital room. I was was sutured without completing the surgery because the pulse was about to break. After that, I am healthy without re-surgery. The feelings I felt during my death experience were just peaceful, and the memory is still so clear. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 1977 April NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Surgery-related. Life threatening event, but not clinical death. Suspension due to pulse during surgery How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes There were three medical staff in the operating room and my parents were crying outside the operating room. A long time later, when I said that I had been treating the diseased area with my large intestine in a large basin, my family agreed. He said that he had witnessed it. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. A feeling of clarity At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I'm floating in the ceiling and exiting to the tunnel. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. Floating in the air and instantly moving into the tunnel, flying at a very high speed. Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I was lying on the operating table, and in my experience, I was floating in near the ceiling and looking down at myself. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I don't know the difference in hearing in particular, but when I passed the tunnel, the sound of the hammer hitting the tunnel was very loud. I clearly left my body and existed outside it . Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes Flying through a very dark tunnel at the speed of light. I heard a loud knock on the tunnel. Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? An unusually bright light Did you see an unearthly light? Yes A very bright light was seen at the end of the tunnel. The colors of the light were a yellow, white, and red swirl. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. Tunnel What emotions did you feel during the experience? Feeling calm Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Unaffiliated- Agnostic Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Unaffiliated- Agnostic Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I thought there was no religion and there was nothing after my death. But after the experience, this is not true. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I must live better to meet a beautiful afterlife. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Yes I didn't see it myself, but I felt like something existed During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes Directly During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes I didn't see it myself, but I felt like something existed Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists I didn't see it myself, but I felt like something existed Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Moderate changes in my life. I don't have much material desires any more. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. I vividly remember the experience despite it happening quickly. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? The whole experience is meaningful Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Family first. Then after 10 years of experience for others, about 10 years ago for others who were curious, but they don't seem to believe me. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. After the experience, the family agreed with me about my experience. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? None Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? Yes

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Heard loud hammering/knocking sounds through the tunnel.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Could not get out of the tunnel until waking up in the hospital room.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Third surgery for intestinal obstruction; surgery suspended due to pulse about to break.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Observed surgery from ceiling; saw parents crying outside operating room; heard hammering/knocking in tunnel; could not exit tunnel until waking in hospital room; surgery stopped due to pulse.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE (ceiling) with observations of operating room and parents outside, then rapid flight through dark tunnel toward bright light, then abrupt awakening back in hospital room without reaching outside the tunnel.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Loud hammering/knocking sounds while traveling through the tunnel; reported being unable to exit the tunnel until waking up in the hospital room.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Suddenly, my body was floating on the ceiling and looking down on my body.” “Suddenly, I was flying through a very dark tunnel at a very high speed.” “I could hear the sound of hammering through the tunnel.” “I couldn't get out of the tunnel until waking up in the hospital room.”
